sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Sumit Bajaj, learned counsel for applicants and Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder for respondent no.1.
3.
Mr. Sumit Bajaj, Advocate, has submitted that the applicant no.1 is the husband of the respondent no.2- informant.
Applicant no.2 is the mother and the applicant no.3 is the father of the applicant no.1.
The allegations of the respondent no.2 are false.

The applicant no.1 has filed a divorce suit,
which is pending before the Family Court, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.
The present FIR is a counterblast to the divorce petition.
4. Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief Holder, has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit.

6. Notice is being issued to the respondent no.2.
7.
Steps to be taken within a week.
8. List on 19.02.2026 along with the record of C528 No.2243 of 2025.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Criminal Case No.1197 of 2025 are stayed qua the applicants.
9. Applicant no.1 and the respondent no.2 are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 19.02.2026.
